$comment: Single source of truth for Docker -> wslc translation. Consumed by the Python package, the npm CLI, the MCP server and the VS Code extension. Do not fork this logic per language. Every claim here is verified against a real wslc on a windows-2025 runner; see `verification`.

unsupported.swarm: Swarm orchestration has no wslc equivalent. Use Kubernetes or keep Docker for this workload.
unsupported.service: Swarm services are not supported by wslc.
unsupported.stack: Swarm stacks are not supported by wslc.
unsupported.node: Swarm node management is not supported by wslc.
unsupported.secret: Swarm secrets are not supported. Pass values with -e or mount a file.
unsupported.config: Swarm configs are not supported by wslc.
unsupported.plugin: Docker plugins are not supported by wslc.
unsupported.context: wslc has a single local runtime, so there are no contexts to switch.
unsupported.buildx: buildx / bake is not available. Use wslc build for single-platform images.
unsupported.manifest: Manifest lists cannot be created with wslc in the preview.
unsupported.trust: Docker Content Trust is Docker-specific and has no wslc equivalent.
unsupported.checkpoint: Checkpoint/restore is not implemented in wslc.
unsupported.restart: No restart command in wslc 2.9.4. Run `wslc stop <id>` then `wslc start <id>`.
unsupported.pause: Pause/unpause (SIGSTOP freezing) is not implemented in wslc 2.9.4.
unsupported.unpause: Pause/unpause is not implemented in wslc 2.9.4.
unsupported.info: No `system info`. `wslc system` only exposes `session`. Use `wslc version` for build info.
unsupported.top: No `top`. Use `wslc exec <id> ps aux` inside the container.
unsupported.wait: No `wait`. Poll `wslc container list` or run the container in the foreground without --detach.
unsupported.port: No `port` command. Published ports are shown in the PORTS column of `wslc container list`.
unsupported.rename: Containers cannot be renamed in wslc 2.9.4. Recreate with the desired --name.
unsupported.diff: No filesystem diff. `wslc export <id>` writes the container filesystem to a tar for inspection.
unsupported.commit: No commit. Use `wslc export` then `wslc import`, or build from a Dockerfile.
unsupported.history: wslc 2.9.4 has no image history. `wslc image inspect` shows config but not per-layer history.
unsupported.search: wslc 2.9.4 cannot search a registry. Browse Docker Hub / the registry web UI instead.

--platform.note: `--platform` is dropped: wslc builds and runs for the host architecture only in the preview.

--restart.note: Restart policies are not implemented in the wslc preview. Flag dropped — use a Windows scheduled task or a wrapper script for auto-restart.

--gpus.note: `--gpus` is native in wslc 2.9.4 (`--gpus all`). Do NOT rewrite it to `--device`: wslc has no --device flag. On a host without an NVIDIA GPU the run fails at container init with an ldconfig error.
--gpus.noteAlways: `--gpus` is native in wslc 2.9.4, but the host must actually have the GPU: on a machine without one, `--gpus all` fails at container init with an ldconfig error.

host.note: wslc rejects host networking outright: `host mode networking is not supported` (exit 1). It is not implicit and cannot be dropped silently. `--network none` works.

--network.note: Custom networks are supported: create with `wslc network create`, then `wslc network connect`. `none` is valid; `host` is rejected.

--volume.noteWhenWindowsPath: Windows host paths are shared over VirtioFS. Use forward slashes (`C:/work:/app`) and expect Linux-style permissions on the container side.

--memory.note: Supported (`-m`). Unit suffix must be UPPERCASE: `512M` works, `512m` is rejected with `Invalid memory argument value`. Plain byte counts also work. Expect a kernel warning that swap limits are unavailable.
--memory.noteWhenValueRejected: wslc rejects lowercase size units: `--memory 512m` fails with `Invalid memory argument value`. Use an UPPERCASE suffix (512M, 1G) or a plain byte count.

--shm-size.note: Supported. Same uppercase-unit rule as --memory: `64M` works, `64m` is rejected.
--shm-size.noteWhenValueRejected: wslc rejects lowercase size units: `--shm-size 64m` fails with `Invalid shm-size argument value`. Use an UPPERCASE suffix (64M, 1G).

--health-cmd.note: Supported. wslc has the full health-check family: --health-cmd, --health-interval, --health-retries, --health-start-period, --health-timeout, --no-healthcheck.

--device.note: wslc 2.9.4 has no --device flag (`Argument name was not recognized`). For GPUs use --gpus.

compose.note: wslc has no built-in Compose runtime. Translate each service into a wslc run call, or drive them from a PowerShell/bash script.

volumes.note: Named volumes must be created first with wslc volume create. Windows paths go over VirtioFS.

networks.note: Bridge-only. Create with wslc network create before running.

cap_add.note: Some capabilities are restricted inside the utility VM.

devices.note: CDI syntax differs from Docker for GPUs.

restart.note: No restart policies in the wslc preview.

healthcheck.note: wslc has no healthcheck support; depends_on conditions relying on it cannot work.

depends_on.note: No dependency ordering. Start services in order yourself and add readiness waits.

configs.note: Swarm configs are unsupported; mount a file instead.

secrets.note: Swarm secrets are unsupported; use -e or a mounted file.

workspaceMount.note: VirtioFS; use forward slashes for Windows paths.

runArgs.note: Passed through verbatim; unsupported flags will fail at runtime.

dockerComposeFile.note: No Compose runtime. Replace with a single image or build entry.

features.note: Requires BuildKit metadata that wslc build does not emit.

requiredSetting.note: Point the Dev Containers extension at wslc. Prefer workspace scope over global.

apiIncompatible.note: CLI-driven tooling ports to wslc. API-driven tooling cannot, because wslc is daemonless and exposes no Docker Engine API or socket.

renamedOptional.$comment: wslc accepts BOTH the docker-style short command and the noun-verb form (verified: `wslc ps` and `wslc container list` both exit 0). These rewrites are cosmetic; converters should not treat the short form as an error.

verification.method: GitHub Actions windows-2025 runner, real wslc invocations

system prune.note: `wslc system` only exposes `session` in 2.9.4 — there is no `system prune`. Run the per-noun prunes instead: `wslc container prune`, `wslc image prune`, `wslc volume prune`, `wslc network prune`.

system info.note: No `system info` in wslc 2.9.4. Use `wslc version`.

system df.note: No `system df` in wslc 2.9.4. Inspect per-noun listings instead.

image prune.note: Removes dangling images; --all removes all unused images.

volume prune.note: Removes unused anonymous volumes; --all includes named ones.
